title: Sound Keyword Mapping
content:
Type: KSSM
Papyrus: None The Sound Keyword Mapping object is found within the Object Window under the Audio Category. This type of object maps the sound Keywords found on the Weapon object to the appropriate Sound Descriptor(s). Editor Dialog: File:Sound Keyword Mapping Editor.png - - Primary Descriptor: Descriptor that is defined in both the Creation Kit and on the animation file of the Weapon. - Exterior Tail: - VATS Descriptor: If VATS has another Descriptor that will play in place of the primary descriptor. - VATS Threshold: - Reverb Descriptors: - See Also: - Keyword - Sound Descriptor - Audio Category
